shortDescription: download a chart from a repository and (optionally) unpack it in local directory.

options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

options.name: chart_ca_cert
options.description: Verify certificates of HTTPS-enabled servers using this CA bundle. Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

options.name: chart_devel
options.description: Use development versions, too. Equivalent to version '>0.0.0-0'. Mutually exclusive with C(chart_version).

options.name: chart_ref
options.description: chart name on chart repository. absolute URL.

options.name: chart_ssl_cert_file
options.description: Identify HTTPS client using this SSL certificate file. Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

options.name: chart_ssl_key_file
options.description: Identify HTTPS client using this SSL key file Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

options.name: chart_version
options.description: Specify a version constraint for the chart version to use. This constraint can be a specific tag (e.g. 1.1.1) or it may reference a valid range (e.g. ^2.0.0). Mutually exclusive with C(chart_devel).

options.name: force
options.description: Force download of the chart even if it already exists in the destination directory. By default, the module will skip downloading if the chart with the same version already exists for idempotency. When used with O(untar_chart=true), will remove any existing chart directory before extracting.

options.name: plain_http
options.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when working with OCI registries Requires Helm >= 3.13.0

options.name: provenance
options.description: Fetch the provenance file, but don't perform verification.

options.name: repo_password
options.description: Chart repository password where to locate the requested chart. Required if C(repo_username) is specified.

options.name: repo_url
options.description: chart repository url where to locate the requested chart.

options.name: repo_username
options.description: Chart repository username where to locate the requested chart. Required if C(repo_password) is specified.

options.name: skip_tls_certs_check
options.description: Whether or not to check tls certificate for the chart download. Requires helm >= 3.3.0. Alias C(insecure_skip_tls_verify) added in 5.3.0.

options.name: untar_chart
options.description: if set to true, will untar the chart after downloading it.

options.name: verify_chart
options.description: Verify the package before using it.

options.name: verify_chart_keyring
options.description: location of public keys used for verification.
